### `async adaptVerifiedPackageArtifact({ artifactBytes, parsedPackage, verification } = {})`

Convert the output of PackageVerifier.parseAny()/verify() into the package input accepted by buildRealmCapsule. Package verification stays owned by the existing package stack; this adapter only binds its verified artifact bytes and roots into the Capsule.
